dominant_strengths: Confident SF-style typography pairs heavy display heading with comfortable body copy at clear hierarchical sizes
Native Mac chrome details — traffic lights, sidebar icons, system blue link — read authentically Apple-platform
Restrained palette of off-white canvas with accent yellow/red/blue/green sidebar icons feels balanced, not noisy
dominant_weaknesses: The tilted product mockup at scroll-400 leaves a vast empty gray gutter top-left, breaking compositional balance
Heading is clipped by viewport top, creating an awkward dead zone rather than a deliberate scroll reveal
Tilt angle is steep enough to make sidebar labels strain readability without adding meaningful 3D drama
fix_priorities: Tighten vertical rhythm so hero copy and tilted app screenshot share the fold rather than separating into voids
Reduce mockup rotation angle or anchor it with a subtle shadow/floor to ground the perspective
Add a secondary visual or caption in the empty left mass to balance the diagonal weight of the screenshot
rationale.norman_balance: Reflective brand confidence outpaces visceral wow and behavioral signaling, since the scroll state reveals more whitespace than narrative.
rationale.intent_fit: It reads as an authentic Things 3 marketing page mid-scroll, but the framing wastes the moment instead of escalating the product reveal.
